items.q: When and why was eBuddha Digitech started?
items.a: eBuddha Digitech has run in Bhopal since 2018, training learners through live projects while also doing digital marketing for businesses. The institute and the agency still work side by side.

items.q: Is eBuddha Digitech a training institute or an agency?
items.a: Both. The institute trains learners for careers in digital marketing and web development, and the agency runs SEO, social media, ads and websites for businesses.

items.q: Do I need prior experience to join a program?
items.a: No. The programs start from the basics, and learners include students after 12th, graduates, working professionals and career switchers.

items.q: What makes your teaching different from watching videos online?
items.a: You learn on live client projects with a mentor who reviews your work, instead of only watching lectures. The classroom course adds face-to-face doubt solving, and the online course records every live session.

items.q: How do I get a quote for SEO, social media, ads or a website?
items.a: Tell us about your business on the enquiry form or WhatsApp +91 84619 58162. We quote after a first conversation, because the scope decides the price. See our services.

items.q: Do you work with businesses outside Bhopal?
items.a: Yes, across India and abroad. Planning, campaigns and reporting all work remotely.
